name: mars-navigator
description: Interactive A* route planning over NASA/USGS Jezero Crater terrain data

scripts.build: npm run data && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check: npm run data && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-routing.mts && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.data: node scripts/build-grid-bin.mjs Data/navigation/navigation_grid.json public/terrain/navigation_grid.bin Data/navigation/grid_metadata.json public/terrain/grid_metadata.json
